description:
A necromancer is a profession considered the noble of nobles, with less than 1,000 in the population worldwide! I was born with a diamond spoon, no, a necromancer spoon in my mouth! ...Or so I thought.

*"I'm just a defective necromancer."*

\[Using skill, "Summon Ordinary Skeleton" (E-rank).\]

You'd think a necromancer should be able to summon liches, Dullahans, or death knights. But nope, I can only summon skeletons. But then one day, suddenly...

\[Hidden condition achieved!\]
\[Condition: The 10,000 Uses Rule\]
\[Your rank has upgraded to D-rank!\]

I achieved the hidden condition and gained the ability to raise my skeletons. From E-rank to S-rank! The story of Joo Donghoon unfolds, the world's only cursed necromancer, who's speeding toward becoming a ranker!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
